messages:
maya: noticed throughput dip after pulling flash-attn upstream (commit 7c4b9e7)
kevin: numbers?
maya: p50 flat, p95 +18% seq=4096 b=4 (85ms -> 100ms). nvprof shows extra kernel stalls.
dinesh: vLLM/xformers changed KV? extra memcpy on cache miss possible.
maya: vLLM PR referenced in infra CI: https://github.com/vllm/vllm/pull/442 — they changed KV eviction ordering for paged attention
infra-bot: [CANARY] flashattn-integration/2024-10-12 failed: p95 regression detected
sam: can we bisect upstream? or patch runtime to avoid paged for these shapes
kevin: run HEAD vs pinned on identical jobs, collect nvprof traces & kernel timings
maya: diff shows upstream added padding path toggling use_paged for some shapes:
```
if (seq_len >= 2048 && head_dim == 128) { use_paged = true; }
```
that forces a gather-prep kernel
dinesh: paged path does per-head gather -> staging memcpy then paged_attn. explains stall
eva: propose heuristic: prefer fused (non-paged) for batch<=8 && head_dim==128 to avoid gather cost
sam: scheduler packer can create micro-batches causing more KV misses; check batching heuristics too
kevin: nvprof excerpt I pasted:
```
Kernel: flash_fused_attn 45.2ms
Kernel: flash_paged_prep 12.8ms
Kernel: flash_paged_attn 50.6ms
Total token-step 108.6ms
```
baseline fused-only: 82.3ms total
maya: paged helps very long seqs but regresses mixed workloads
dinesh: runtime change: gate paged path only when seq_len>3072 OR token_density > 0.6
maya: adding bench/paged_kv_repro.py to vary KV hit ratio
sam: branch runtime/avoid-paged-small-batches created with config prefer_paged: auto|never|always
kevin: need perf matrix before merge
maya: local run on branch: p95 back to 86ms for failing workload. throughput ok
eva: run full matrix seq=[512,1024,2048,4096] batch=[1,2,4,8], dump to s3
dinesh: open upstream issue on flash-attn with repro and perf cliff note
maya: filed https://github.com/flash-attn/flash-attn/issues/721 with perf numbers
infra-bot: [CIRCLECI] runtime-e2e #128 failed tests: pytest::tests::kv_cache_behavior_test AssertionError: expected cache hit ratio >= 0.7 got 0.42
sam: tweak eviction TTL in test, re-run CI
kevin: action items: 1) smoke merge branch to canary (sam) 2) perf matrix on dedicated infra (kevin) 3) upstream PR draft (dinesh) 4) RFC on kernel-selection (eva)
maya: assigning owners @kevin @dinesh @sam @eva :eyes:
